title: dianthus cintranus subsp. atrosanguineus
intro: Dianthus cintranus subsp. atrosanguineus, commonly known as the 'Dark-Frilled Pink' or 'Red-Flowered Carnation', is a subspecies of the Dianthus cintranus plant. It is known for its fragrant, dark red or pink flowers and has been used for its medicinal properties. The plant is believed to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Dianthus cintranus subsp. atrosanguineus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including sedative and antimicrobial effects.
